name: Ülar
source:
Originally an antagonist who injures Ülar and causes most of his insecurities throughout the game, but becomes the protagonist starting from the true route after entering the keyboard when Ülar loses connection with the player due to an untimely death caused by him. 

He is a Diviner and is searching for a artefact called the Titan-Bell to bring back Theo for his own personal goals.
translation:
Originally an antagonist who injures Ülar and causes most of his insecurities throughout the game, but becomes the protagonist starting from the true route after entering the keyboard when Ülar loses connection with the player due to an untimely death caused by him. 

He is a Diviner and is searching for a artefact called the Titan-Bell to bring back Theo for his own personal goals.
